description.narrative: "The Queer African Youth Network (QAYN) is a feminist organization with the goal ofbuilding a broad support network to promote the well-being and safetyof lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender and queer people in West Africa.QAYN works with LGBTQ-led groups/organizations withleadership held by lesbian, bisexual, queer and/or trans* women in West Africaand Cameroon.The Equality Fund grant will be used to fund operational expenses,including a portion of operating costs. This grant also supports:-Strengthening organizational capacity, including the leadership and professionalcapacity of QAYN co-leaders and staff, for the sustainability of thenetwork and its mission.-Improving QAYN's flagship activity: the feminist activist school.-Involving girls, queer and trans* women in regional orglobal meetings to increase their visibility and the actions theytake. undertake.- Capacity building of LBTQ activists from Francophone West Africaand Cameroon.- Promotion and visibility of LBTQ activists in spaces for reflection,discussions and political decision-making"
